step 2: create /etc/paisans

step 3: record the sysctls' values before
  sysctls: /etc/paisans/sysctl.before, for site evict to restore
  write /etc/paisans/sysctl.before mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans site admit: each value as it was before admit
    | # first changed it. paisans site evict restores them.
    | net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0
    | net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start = 1024

step 27: set the host's sysctls
  sysctls: /etc/sysctl.d/60-paisans.conf, applied with sysctl --system, which applies every sysctl file on the host again, then each key checked, since a file read after it could set one back
  write /etc/sysctl.d/60-paisans.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans site admit, for every admitted deployment that needs
    | # it; paisans site evict restores each value once none does.
    | net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start = 80
    | net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
  run:
    $ sysctl --system >/dev/null && { [ "$(sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start)" = 80 ] || { echo 'net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start is not 80 after sysctl --system: a file read after /etc/sysctl.d/60-paisans.conf sets it'; exit 1; }; } && { [ "$(sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_forward)" = 1 ] || { echo 'net.ipv4.ip_forward is not 1 after sysctl --system: a file read after /etc/sysctl.d/60-paisans.conf sets it'; exit 1; }; }

step 29: add the operators' keys

warning: delegation reaches paisans-f2a9's manager at its next start
  Its manager is running, and restarting it would restart its Docker daemon and every container in it, so admit does not. cpuset and io limits apply after the host's next reboot.
warning: public ports: every local user on this host may bind ports 80 to 1023
  net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start = 80 is host wide: no user's process needs root for a port from 80 up, the deployment's Caddy among them.
warning: forwarding: this turns on routing between every interface on this host
  The site has an endpoint, so it relays mesh traffic between sites behind NAT, which cannot dial each other. The firewall's forward policy governs what is routed.
